raw:
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "请列出各城市在最近30天内，按客户贡献度排序的销售金额和订单数量。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按城市分组，统计2026-08-14至2026-09-12期间所有有效订单的总paid_amount（销售金额）与总订单数（count(*)），并按销售金额降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "销售金额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中‘客户贡献度’未明确定义为金额、订单数、付费用户数或人均金额等；业务中常见解释包括销售金额（主流）、订单数量（次常用）、付费用户数（另类视角），三者物理含义与业务动因不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["销售金额", "订单数量"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:sum_paid_amount_count_orders_30d_order_by_sum_paid_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计各品牌在上个月的销售额与销售数量，并按品牌销售额排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌分组，统计2026-08-01至2026-08-31期间所有有效订单对应商品的item_amount总和（品牌销售额）与quantity总和（品牌销售数量），并按品牌销售额降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "品牌销售额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘销售额’在品牌粒度下可指订单级paid_amount之和（按订单归属品牌推断，不严谨），或更准确的order_items.item_amount之和（按实际销售商品归属）；二者因多品订单、跨品牌订单等场景存在系统性差异。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["品牌销售额（order_items.item_amount求和）", "品牌销售额（orders.paid_amount求和）"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands:sum_item_amount_sum_quantity_aug2026_order_by_sum_item_amount_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS brand_sales_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS brand_sales_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY brand_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请输出各省份在最近7天内的客户购买力指标与订单总数，并按客户购买力排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按省份分组，统计2026-09-06至2026-09-12期间所有有效订单的平均单客付费金额（paid_amount / paying_users）与总订单数，并按平均单客付费金额降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "平均单客付费金额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘客户购买力指标’未明确是均值（如人均付费）、总量（如总销售额）、中位数或TOP N用户贡献占比；业务报表中‘购买力’常指人均付费，但亦有场景用总销售额代称，二者量纲与管理意义截然不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["平均单客付费金额", "总销售额"],
      "semantic_signature": "provinces:avg_paid_per_paying_user_count_orders_7d_order_by_avg_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.province, AVG(o.paid_amount) AS avg_paid_per_paying_user, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-06' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.province ORDER BY avg_paid_per_paying_user DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请给出各城市在9月前10天的销售贡献排名，包含销售金额和销售数量。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按城市分组，统计2026-09-01至2026-09-10期间所有有效订单的paid_amount总和（销售金额）与quantity总和（销售数量），并按销售金额降序取前10名。",
      "simulated_answer": "销售金额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘销售贡献排名’未指定排序依据：可为销售金额（主流）、销售数量（侧重规模）、付费用户数（侧重覆盖）、或销售金额占比（相对贡献）；不同依据导致城市排名显著不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["销售金额", "销售数量"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:sum_paid_amount_sum_quantity_sep1to10_order_by_sum_paid_desc_top10",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-10' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 10;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请展示各品牌在8月的业绩表现，含销售额与销售件数，并按业绩表现排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌分组，统计2026-08-01至2026-08-31期间所有有效订单对应商品的item_amount总和（销售额）与quantity总和（销售件数），并按销售额降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "销售额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘业绩表现’为模糊业务术语：可量化为销售额（财务结果）、销售件数（运营规模）、毛利率（盈利质量）、或新品销售占比（发展健康度）；本题上下文仅支持金额与件数，二者不可互换。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["销售额", "销售件数"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands:sum_item_amount_sum_quantity_aug2026_order_by_sum_item_amount_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出各城市在最近15天内对平台的商业价值贡献，含销售金额和订单数，并按商业价值排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按城市分组，统计2026-08-29至2026-09-12期间所有有效订单的paid_amount总和（销售金额）与订单总数，并按销售金额降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "销售金额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘商业价值贡献’属高层抽象表述，未绑定具体指标：可指销售金额（直接营收）、毛利额（需成本字段，不可算）、LTV预估（无历史行为数据支撑）、或GMV（含未支付订单，不符合valid orders定义）；当前schema仅支持销售金额与订单数。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["销售金额", "订单数"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:sum_paid_amount_count_orders_15d_order_by_sum_paid_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-29' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计各省份在9月上半月的销售产出与订单产出，并按销售产出排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按省份分组，统计2026-09-01至2026-09-15期间所有有效订单的paid_amount总和（销售产出）与订单总数（订单产出），并按销售产出降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "销售产出",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘销售产出’与‘订单产出’虽成对出现，但‘产出’一词本身未限定计算口径：销售产出可为paid_amount（标准）、gross_amount（含折扣前）、或item_amount（商品级）；其中paid_amount符合valid orders定义，其余不满足业务合同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["销售产出（paid_amount）", "销售产出（gross_amount）"],
      "semantic_signature": "provinces:sum_paid_amount_count_orders_sep1to15_order_by_sum_paid_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.province, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_output, COUNT(*) AS order_output FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' GROUP BY u.province ORDER BY sales_output DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请输出各品牌在最近30天的市场占有率指标与销售数量，并按市场占有率排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌分组，统计2026-08-14至2026-09-12期间所有有效订单对应商品的item_amount占全站item_amount总和的比例（品牌市场占有率）与quantity总和，并按市场占有率降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "品牌市场占有率",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘市场占有率指标’未说明分母基准：可为全站销售额（标准定义）、全站订单数（非标准）、或全站商品SKU数（无意义）；且分子可为item_amount（商品级）或paid_amount（订单级），前者更精准反映品牌真实份额。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["品牌市场占有率（item_amount占比）", "品牌市场占有率（paid_amount占比）"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands:rate_brand_item_amount_of_total_sum_quantity_30d_order_by_rate_desc",
      "reference_sql": "WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(oi.item_amount) AS total_item_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12') SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) / t.total_item_amount AS market_share, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id CROSS JOIN total t WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.brand, t.total_item_amount ORDER BY market_share DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请展示各城市在9月1日至12日期间的客户活跃度指标与订单总数，并按客户活跃度排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按城市分组，统计2026-09-01至2026-09-12期间的付费用户数（COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id)）与订单总数，并按付费用户数降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "付费用户数",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘客户活跃度指标’未明确定义：可为付费用户数（核心活跃）、下单用户数（同义）、访问用户数（无日志表不支持）、或人均订单频次（需分母）；当前schema仅支持付费用户数作为最简合理代理。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["付费用户数", "订单总数"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:count_distinct_paying_users_count_orders_sep1to12_order_by_count_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paying_users, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY paying_users DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出各品牌在8月的经营健康度指标与销售金额，并按经营健康度排序。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌分组，统计2026-08-01至2026-08-31期间的已批准退款金额占该品牌销售金额的比例（品牌退款率）与item_amount总和（销售金额），并按退款率升序排列（健康度越高，退款率越低）。",
      "simulated_answer": "品牌退款率",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘经营健康度指标’为管理术语，未绑定具体计算：可为退款率（负向指标，越低越健康）、复购率（无跨期订单表不支持）、退款率倒数（正向转换）、或毛利率（缺cost_price关联条件）；退款率是唯一可计算且业务公认的健康度代理指标。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["品牌退款率", "品牌退款率倒数"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands:refund_rate_sum_item_amount_aug2026_order_by_refund_rate_asc",
      "reference_sql": "WITH brand_sales AS (SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS brand_sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.brand), brand_refunds AS (SELECT p.brand, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS brand_refund_amount FROM products p LEFT JOIN refunds r ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.brand) SELECT bs.brand, COALESCE(br.brand_refund_amount / NULLIF(bs.brand_sales_amount, 0), 0) AS health_metric, bs.brand_sales_amount AS sales_amount FROM brand_sales bs LEFT JOIN brand_refunds br ON bs.brand = br.brand ORDER BY health_metric ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
